parameters.name: CloudCode
parameters.description:
The code of the cloud service provider. Valid values:

*   qcloud: Tencent Cloud
*   aliyun: Alibaba Cloud
*   hcloud: Huawei Cloud

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region in which the data management center of the threat analysis feature resides. Specify this parameter based on the regions in which your assets reside. Valid values:

*   cn-hangzhou: Your assets reside in regions in China.
*   ap-southeast-1: Your assets reside in regions outside China.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloud-siem list-bind-account --cloud-code hcloud --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --role-for 1130916744880000 --role-type 1 --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
